maria (ml): heads up — lucent13b int4 onboard failing intermittently under load, mostly long-context convo workloads. seeing OOMs after ~10k tokens cumulative per session.
aj (infra): logs? is it coldstart or steady-state fragmentation?
maria (ml): steady-state. small microbatches (batch_size=4) but lots of long histories. stack traces point to KV allocations, then slab fragmentation. snippet: ```\nmodel=lucent13b\nquant=int4\nbatch_size=4\nmax_output_tokens=1024\nprefetch=true\n``` 
kevin (runtime): interesting — int4 + prefetch + long kv chains can blow the freelist. two quick checks: 1) are we doing full KV prefetch for every request? 2) kernel affinity forcing big kernels onto same GPU?
maria (ml): prefetch is aggressive by default for this model. affinity is default balanced.
sana (prodex): can we try a Canary config with prefetched_kv: conservative and lower max_output_tokens to 512 for lucent13b? should keep quality impact measurable.
aj (infra): pushed a canary policy to a couple nodes, reduced prefetch window and set `kv_eviction_threshold=0.7` (was 0.9). deploy-bot: rolled out lucent13b: canary -> 2 nodes (tag: canary/lucent13b/2026-03-23) :rocket:
maria (ml): running evaluation suite (SQuAD-ish + convo QA). baseline P95 latency 420ms, mem RSS peeks ~22.8GB, error rate ~0.9% failures.
kevin (runtime): watch for mem fragmentation metric `slab_free_runaway` — if it trends down while RSS stable, we have leakage into freelist fragmentation. also try `kv_prefetch_shrink=true` to allocate prefetch pages lazily.
sana (prodex): also run a quality A/B — int8 fallback vs pure int4. we saw ~0.8% exact-match drop on int4 for answers with long context in earlier models. want to quantify here.
maria (ml): quick results: canary w/ max_output_tokens=512 + kv_eviction_threshold=0.7 dropped failure rate to 0.2% on canary nodes. P95 latency up ~30ms. quality delta: int4-only vs int8-fallback gave -0.6% EM on our QA set.
aj (infra): good. lower failures are huge. tradeoff seems acceptable if we adjust default max_output_tokens down for hosted lucent13b. ops-bot: alert: canary saw 0 OOMs in last 30m, reporting window=1800s.
kevin (runtime): propose default policy: for lucent13b quant=int4 defaults -> {prefetch: conserv, max_output_tokens: 512, kv_eviction_threshold:0.75, soft_eviction_latency_penalty: true}. add auto-fallback to int8 above 16k cumulative tokens/session.
sana (prodex): agree. also add a rollout note in console: "lucent13b int4 defaults tuned for long-context stability; use dedicated nodes for higher max tokens".
maria (ml): we'll run 24h canary with those defaults, and capture eval set for regressions. if accuracy drop >1% we revert to int8-fallback sooner.
kevin (runtime): one more: enable slot-compactor background job at low priority (`compactor.qos=low`) to reclaim fragmented slots asynchronously. should cut steady-state mem churn.
aj (infra): scheduled compactor job on canary hosts.
maria (ml): thanks — will post final numbers tomorrow. short-term action items: lower hosted default max_output_tokens for lucent13b to 512, conservative prefetch, enable slot compactor, kv_eviction tweak, add int8-fallback policy.
sana (prodex): I'll update release notes + rollout checklist.
maria (ml): tl;dr — localization done, mitigation plan in canary, early metrics promising. will follow up with full eval export. :thumbsup:
